Application Use Reminder
The data contained in this app should not be used in place of a survey. This data is for visualization purposes only and should not be used to solve property conflicts, plan construction, or determine public access. For authoritative boundary lines please consult relevant deeds and documents or contact a professional surveyor.
Property boundaries displayed here are updated to coincide with the yearly tax roll update. For instance a property being divided in two won’t show as separate until after March.
Local Unit Tax Data
The following local units calculate their own taxes for summer and winter. Their tax data will not be available until after March 1st.
Arbela Township
Fremont Township
Tuscola Township
City of Vassar
Application Use:
This map is neither a legally recorded map nor a survey and is not intended to be used as such. The information on Tuscola County websites, are distributed and transmitted ‘as is’ without warranties of any kind, either expressed or implied, including without limitations, warranties of title or implied warranties of merchantability or fitness for a particular purpose. Tuscola County does not guarantee the accuracy, timeliness, or completeness of the information on this website.
GIS/Mapping:
The Geographic Information System (GIS) made available through this website is developed and maintained by Tuscola County. Use of materials and information constitutes acceptance of all disclaimers associated with these websites. GIS data is not the official record of the County. This data is made available for information purposes only!
Consumer's Collection System Phase I Data Notice: This information is for design purposes only and is not reliable for construction. All locations are approximate, facilities may have been added and/or altered after any revision or as-printed date, and service lines may not be shown. Field staking is available at no charge by calling MISS DIG (800-482-7171) three working days in advance of the digging, and the precise location and depth of all underground facilities must be identified in accordance with the MISS DIG Act, PA 174 of 2013 as amended, and any other applicable law or ordinance. Use of these maps does not relieve the user of any legal duty to comply with all applicable laws or ordinances.
